AmbientOS is an AI-powered company orchestration platform where 8 autonomous agents run departments under human (CEO) governance. The system operates on a **propose -> approve -> execute -> audit** cycle, with a heartbeat that fires every 30 minutes.

Quick Orientation: **Brand hierarchy:** AmbientPixels (company) -> AmbientOS (platform) -> AmbientScore (product)

**All code lives under ** — not at the repo root. This is the #1 mistake new sessions make.

The 8 Agents: **Processing order per heartbeat:** nova -> cipher -> pixel -> forge -> scribe -> quill -> echo -> scout

Echo runs AFTER Scribe/Quill so peer reviews complete before social posting.



---

Social Pipeline: Echo briefs -> Scribe writes copy -> Quill reviews brand voice -> CEO approves -> platform post

Platforms: LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Facebook (manual), Reddit (manual — CEO copies from outbox)

Key rule: **Echo NEVER writes post copy.** Echo strategizes, Scribe writes, Quill polishes.

Blog Pipeline: Scribe drafts (kind=) -> Pixel generates hero image -> Scribe submits for publish -> CEO approves -> optional social promo auto-spawns

AmbientScore is AmbientPixels' standalone AI website conversion audit product. Users enter a URL, get an instant 0-100 score with a letter grade, see 3 teaser findings for free, and can unlock the full report ($49 single / $149 3-pack). The product lives at and is self-contained — its own CSS, JS, and API layer.

The 8-Dimension Scoring Model: The scoring model is the intellectual core of the product. It lives in and drives everything from prompt construction to report rendering.

Adding a new dimension: 1. Define in : name, description, sub-criteria, weight in ALL site-type profiles
2. Add evaluation prompt in (assign to Group A or B)
3. Update to display the new dimension
4. Verify picks it up (it reads from dynamically)

Changing pricing: - Stripe prices are configured in (price IDs)
- Display prices in (landing page CTAs) and (paywall section)
- Credit pack size in
